description: Jump the virtual clock forward by N seconds and fire every timer that falls due in that window (earliest first), so sleep(), timeouts, countdowns and inactivity logic pass instantly and deterministically. os.clock()/os.epoch() move too. Timers due later keep their real deadline. Then waits for the program to settle.

seconds.description: How far to jump, in seconds (up to a day).

timeoutMs.description: Longest wait for the program to settle afterwards.

name: craftos_advance
